root_cause: Two stacked defects. (1) FRESHNESS: the correction path re-verifies the artifact without requiring evidence the re-dispatched agent actually rewrote it (content-hash or mtime vs the blocked snapshot). An agent that dies pre-write (context exhaustion, tmux delivery loss) yields a re-validation of stale bytes, indistinguishable from 'agent produced the same bad output again'. (2) DIAGNOSABILITY: the sentinel parser collapses 'trailing data after a complete JSON object' into 'no parseable verdict', so the correction prompt sent the agent chasing a missing verdict that was 99.97% present.
